title: A Cipher for the Confession
author: Oscar Ravensworth
blurb: Freya Nystrom, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
